about: Painted features on the wall of RA-A-1 (AI-generated, sheet RA-A's step-1 picture), the kit's fixed obstacles, measured for the Lead's rule of 19 November (version 4). Picture pixels of the 1024 x 1536 painting; a polygon holds the pixels whose centres lie inside it. Each outline was read from RA-A-1's brightness profiles across it, its dark outline and any contact shadow included.
rule: Every step-2 and step-3 mask edge either clearly overlaps a feature in the test, covering it with at least 15 px to spare, or clears it by at least 15 px (square pixels): no part of the feature lies within 15 px of a mask edge. A named exception, for the Lead's decision, passes only where every such part lies in its zone. The features not in the test are measured and reported.

features.name: pipe run
features.measured: two pipes along the back wall's foot, from the lower junction box (they bend down into its right side near x 245) to the corner pipes; the upper pipe's top y 966 at x 208, 931 at x 265, 919 at x 385, 912 at x 440, 902 at x 530, 891 at x 604; the lower pipe's foot with its shadow y 1004 at x 208, 972 at x 265, 954 at x 385, 946 at x 440, 936 at x 530, 922 at x 604

features.name: locker bank
features.measured: frame outline: left x 134 (its shadow from 128), right x 337; top y 599 at x 150 to 618 at x 320; foot y 915 at x 140 to 899 at x 335

exceptions.why: The rail above the lockers (not on the list) runs 12 to 14 px above their top, and under the upper junction box only 21 to 31 px separate the box's foot from the lockers' top. The box keeps its 15 px (17); the edge runs in the strip of plain wall between rail and lockers, about 6 px from each.

Between x 128 and 205 the lockers' foot outline and the lower junction box are 13 to 15 rows apart, the outline running straight into its own shadow. The box keeps its 15 px: the outline's lowest one or two rows stay outside the mask there, on the top of the shadow band, which step 2 leaves; further right the foot is covered by 0 to 5 px, the pipe run 19 px below.
